We've been thinking carefully about how an AI feedback platform could fit into first-year composition, and I do have some important updates to our thinking that I'd like to share with the group. But first, let me outline our general pedagogical concerns. Our primary focus is ensuring that any AI-generated feedback supports rather than replaces instructor judgment, particularly when it comes to the formative stages of the writing process. We want to make sure students are getting feedback that helps them develop as writers, not just feedback that corrects surface-level issues. I should note that I have a recently finalized pilot standard that bears directly on these pedagogical considerations, and I think it's important that I share it with everyone here before we go further.
